subject.title: feat: Plugin API for TUI footer status contributions (registerStatusProvider)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public PluginStatusProvider/registerStatusProvider SDK seam now, and if so what method name, return shape, multiplicity, and TUI rendering boundary should it commit to?
rationale: This is a new public Plugin SDK contract, not a broken existing behavior, and repository policy treats plugin API additions as compatibility-sensitive once released.

options.title: Approve the narrow API after refresh
options.body: Refresh the candidate PR, settle the method and return shape, and land the registry/API seam while leaving footer rendering design to the broader tracker.

options.title: Pause behind footer design
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers decide the final footer rendering/order/truncation semantics that should drive the SDK shape.

options.title: Decline core SDK surface
options.body: Close the core request only if maintainers decide existing plugin, command, or Control UI surfaces are the intended path for this status information.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow API after refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh the candidate PR, settle the method and return shape, and land the registry/API seam while leaving footer rendering design to the broader tracker.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest current-history owner for the touched Plugin SDK and TUI footer surfaces.
